We cursed the walls for caging us, never realizing they were the only thing keeping our dark nature inside. The ultimate tragedy of seeking freedom isn't the blood on your hands—it’s standing beyond the ocean, looking back, and realizing you became the very monster you sacrificed everything to destroy.
